# Egress allow-list for build-test.yaml / 'Python Build'.
# See .github/harden-runner/README.md for how it is loaded and how to
# update it. Each entry names the process seen calling it in
# harden-runner audit telemetry, or the documented reason for it.

# Checkout and python-build-action's GitHub API queries
github.com:443
api.github.com:443
# setup-uv and setup-python downloads and version manifests
releases.astral.sh:443
raw.githubusercontent.com:443
release-assets.githubusercontent.com:443
# Build dependencies (uv, pip)
pypi.org:443
files.pythonhosted.org:443
# build-metadata looks up Python support dates
endoflife.date:443
# A Go module download by the action's metadata tooling
proxy.golang.org:443
